Game Overview

Baldman Run is a platformer game built around guide Baldman through a fast-paced, endless platforming adventure. Leap across shifting terrains, dodge surprise foes from every direction, and gather special items to maximize your score. Each run presents a thrilling test of reflexes and timing, packed with unexpected challenges. How far can Baldman go in this exhilarating run?
